ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.

3. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

4. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

5. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.

6. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.

7. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

9. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

11. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.

12. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

8. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

10. C — Information and Communication Technology

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
